تنتجعي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِعِي (tantajiʕī) /tan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# تُنْتَجَعِي (tuntajaʕī) /tun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
